assumption: This gate assumes b=r_e and r_e^2=pi*G*q^2/g_R^2. mu=G*Mphysical is a length; it is not the magnetic-null budget M of increment108.

RN_branch.allowed_interval: b <= mu < (Rout^2+b^2)/(2*Rout), assuming Rout>b and mu>=b.
RN_branch.explanation: For mu>=b, rminus<=b<Rout. Thus F(Rout)>0 selects the exterior region beyond rplus, not the region inside rminus. Equality at the upper mass puts the horizon on the cut and is excluded.

endpoint_derivation.asymptotic_clock: C=1 in the compact table. C is a positive constant for general derivations.
endpoint_derivation.clock_does_not_repair_geometry: Changing C changes lapse normalization but leaves r_prime, N_prime/N, and angular extrinsic curvature unchanged. Saved108 outer r_prime=1 cannot match any allowed branch r_prime<=.2.

width_gate.hypothesis: A nonovershooting opening: r_prime(0)=0, 0<=r_prime(x)<=vout, r_prime(w)=vout, with continuous derivative.
width_gate.strict_inequality: DeltaR=integral r_prime dx < w*vout, hence w>DeltaR/vout.
width_gate.limitation: This is not a no-go for all collars. Within the black-hole branch, a radius-monotone collar of width .1 could evade this bound only by overshooting r_prime>.5 somewhere before ending at r_prime<=.2. No such alternative geometry is constructed here.

below_extremal_mass_escape.assumption: Formal RN exterior with mu<b outside an excised/replaced core; no black-hole horizon branch is assumed here.
below_extremal_mass_escape.interpretation: For w=.1 and DeltaR=.05, the nonovershooting width condition requires vout>.5, equivalently mu<.17375: a deficit exceeding13.125% of b. This is an algebraic necessary condition, not a constructed collar or a calculation of achievable quantum mass reduction.
below_extremal_mass_escape.global_scope: An RN formula with mu<b need not represent a physical naked singularity when its central region is excised and replaced. Global regularity, field equations and the actual two-mouth exterior must be solved separately.

null_integral.RN_matching_boundary_term: With r_prime(inner)=0 and Nout=C*vout, the boundary contribution is -1/(C*Rout); the unknown collar bulk integral is nonnegative.
null_integral.strict_sign: Any positive-lapse collar with these endpoints and a nonzero radius increase has Q<-1/(C*Rout). This does not specify the remaining tensor or its source.
null_integral.clock_scaling: For t_new=alpha*t and the SAME affinely parameterized null geodesic: N_new=N/alpha, E_new=E/alpha, I_new=I, Q_new=alpha*Q. E*Q=4*pi*G*I and the sign are invariant; Q alone is not clock invariant.
null_integral.affine_scaling: If lambda_new=beta*lambda, k_new=k/beta, E_new=E/beta and I_new=I/beta, so Q is invariant under affine rescaling.
null_integral.warning: The saved108 number belongs to its original flat-matching collar; it is not the integral for an unconstructed RN-matching collar.

tensor_diagnostic.basis: Static orthonormal frame, metric signature(-,+,+,+): covariant tensor diag(rho,p_r,p_t,p_t), with all off-diagonal components zero for this spherical monopole diagnostic.
tensor_diagnostic.normalization: Every energy density, pressure, null sum, and trace is multiplied by 8*pi*G and has dimension inverse length squared (d=1). Ward residual has dimension inverse length cubed.
tensor_diagnostic.numerical_normalization: Ward error divided by1+sum of absolute values of its three terms; trace error divided by1+abs(rho)+abs(p_r)+2abs(p_t)+abs(Ricci), using the scaled tensor.
tensor_diagnostic.field_subtracted: Only the radial monopole Maxwell tensor is subtracted. The angular multipole Maxwell stress from108 and any higher-curvature effective terms are not subtracted; this is not a unique quantum-source target.
tensor_diagnostic.angular_scope: Spherical monopole diagnostic only. The actual corrected magnetic field is nonspherical and also requires nonspherical Einstein equations or compensating stress.

independent_high_precision_arithmetic.purpose: Distinguishes cancellation roundoff in float checks from a formula defect; not an enclosure of the saved physical profiles.

scope: A rejection and parameter gate for an isolated black-hole RN exterior under an explicit classical magnetic-radius interpretation. It is not an exact two-mouth or global dihole solution.

The compact table includes extremal mu=b and strictly subextremal black holes b<mu<.205. A separate analytic mu<b escape is recorded; the black-hole branch gate does not exclude every possible quantum exterior.
The RN clock may be rescaled, but extrinsic geometry cannot be repaired by a clock choice. A collar must be designed against physically compatible boundary data.
Saved108 geometry remains a legitimate prescribed smooth test background. The nonzero tensor residual identifies stress that would be required to interpret it gravitationally.
Neither a new collar nor a supporting source is constructed. No original smooth, Maxwell, quantum, Dirac, or other field ODE is rerun.
